n: <int> Number of nodes in the logistics network, each serving as both a potential hub location and a source or destination of commodity flow.

cost_parameters.collection_cost_chi: <float> Per-unit-distance cost rate for transporting flow from an origin node to its assigned hub.
cost_parameters.transfer_cost_alpha: <float> Discounted per-unit-distance cost rate for transporting consolidated flow between two hubs.
cost_parameters.distribution_cost_delta: <float> Per-unit-distance cost rate for transporting flow from a destination's assigned hub to the destination node.
cost_parameters.routing_cost_formula: <str> Formula expressing the routing cost for sending flow from origin i to destination j via hubs k and m.

total_flow_D: <float> Total outgoing flow across all nodes in the network.
coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [n][2]> Geographic x and y coordinates of each node.
flow_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [n][n]> Quantity of commodity flow originating at node i and destined for node j.
distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [n][n]> Euclidean distance between each pair of nodes, scaled by a factor of 1/1000.
outgoing_flow: <list[float], length n> Total flow originating at each node, summed over all destinations.
setup_costs: <list[float], length n> Fixed cost incurred for opening a hub at each node.
capacities: <list[float], length n> Maximum total incoming flow that each node can handle if opened as a hub.
